'''''Koh-Lanta: La Revanche des 4 Terres''''' is the thirty-second season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''.

After 40 days, [[Gaëlle Fleury]] defeated [[Maël Lozach]] in a 7-4 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].
==Twists/Changes==
* '''Four Tribes:''' For the second time in ''Koh-Lanta'' history, the game starts with four [[Tribe|tribes]] instead of the usual two.
* '''Tribes Divided by Geographic Origin:''' The four tribes are divided according to where the castaways are from: the {{tribeicon|timog}}, {{tribeicon|kanluran}}, {{tribeicon|silangan}} and {{tribeicon|hilaga}} tribes consist of castaways from Southern, Western, Eastern, and Northern France respectively.
* '''Exile Islet:''' At every [[Reward Challenge]] of the four-tribe phase, the tribe placing first gets to choose among two available rewards, and the tribe placing second wins the remaining reward. The tribe placing third goes back to their camp empty-handed, while the tribe placing last is sent to Exile Islet for 24 hours, a small island with very little resources and no water.
* '''[[Double Tribal Council]]:''' At the Day 10 [[Immunity Challenge]], only the tribe placing first and second win immunity, sending the other two losing tribes to Tribal Council to vote out one person each.
* '''Impromptu Tribal Council:''' During the double Tribal Council twist, while the tribes third in the Immunity Challenge go to Tribal Council normally the day after, the tribe that finishes last has its Tribal Council held immediately after the challenge, at the challenge site.
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:''' On Day 12, the four original tribes are dissolved. An individual Reward Challenge is held where the first and second-place finishers become the captains of the two new tribes, {{tribeicon2|tugawe32fr|Tugawe}} and {{tribeicon|virak}}, which are formed in a [[Schoolyard Pick]].
* '''[[Ambassadors]]:''' At the merge, both tribes must send two of their members to the ambassadors meeting, where they must directly eliminate a castaway from the game. One member from each of {{tribeicon|timog}} and {{tribeicon|silangan}} is chosen to represent {{tribeicon|virak}}, while one member from each of {{tribeicon|kanluran}} and {{tribeicon|hilaga}} is chosen represent {{tribeicon2|tugawe32fr|Tugawe}}. If the four ambassadors do not agree on a name, one of them is eliminated by a rock draw.
* '''{{Dab-twist|Tied Destinies}}:''' On Day 30, the ten remaining castaways are divided into five pairs. Four of them are decided by a rock draw, whereas the fifth one is designed by the choice of the winner of the first round of the [[Reward Challenge]] of the final ten. Until the next Tribal Council, the fate of each contestant is linked to their partner: the challenges are competed by pairs, and the person voted out at Tribal Council causes their partner's demise.

==Trivia==
* Like {{S2|25fr}}, 
**One of the four [[Tokalo|original]] [[Timog|tribes]] managed to survive until the [[Tribe Switch|tribe switch]] without losing a single member, by never visiting Tribal Council until their dissolution (a feat also shared with [[Hilaga]], but unlike the other two aforementioned tribes, they lost two members before the switch).
**The [[Vualiku|Northern]] [[Hilaga|tribe]] had a former member of the [[Vakara|Western]] [[Kanluran|tribe]] among themselves at some point to replace one of [[Samuel Degoute|their]] [[Allan Rousseeuw|members]] who was [[Evacuation|medically evacuated]].
**[[François Zabalo|T]][[Samuel Degoute|wo]] [[Allan Rousseeuw|cont]][[Frédéric Pignard|estants]] were medically evacuated because of physical injuries.
**The captains of the two new [[Sayake|r]][[Tugawe|ed]] and [[Vuro|ye]][[Virak|llow]] tribes were a [[Alix Noblat|female]] from [[Naïs Napoletano|Southern France]] and a [[Bertrand-Kamal Loudrhiri|male]] from [[Maxime Lubian|Eastern France]].
**The [[Mohamed Ayari|person]] [[Adrien Ferreira|voted out]] at the first post-swap Tribal Council, was a male from the [[Hilaga|Northern]] [[Vualiku|Tribe]] who was in the [[Tugawe (France)|Red]] [[Sayake|Tribe]]. The two people who received the most votes against them were a [[Naïs Napoletano|fem]][[Joaquina Pereira Nunes|ale]] from the [[Timog|majority regio]][[Tokalo|nal tribe]] and this male from the Northern tribe.
**One [[Marie-France Schieber|member of]] [[Adrien Bernaert|the jury]] was evacuated due to personal reasons.
**The partner of the contestant voted out during the Tied Destinies twist was a former member of the [[Ceva|Southern]] [[Timog|tribe]], who then became a member of the [[Vuro|yellow]] [[Virak|tribe]] following the tribe switch.
**A [[Lola Labesse|female]] from [[Claire Passas|Northern France]] and a [[Dorian Louvet|male]] from [[Jérôme Salvatore|Western France]] both lost the [[Orienteering]] challenge.
**There were [[Dorian Louvet|two]] [[Jody Favier|contestants]] from [[Jérôme Salvatore|Western]] [[Noémie Bessec|France]] on the jury.
**The person who finished third was a [[Loïc Riowal|ma]][[Jérôme Molas|le]] from the [[Tokalo|majority regi]][[Timog|onal tribe]], that was also a member (and the highest placed one) of the [[Vuro|yellow]] [[Virak|tribe]]. 
**The Sole Survivor was a [[Alexandra Pornet|female]] from [[Gaëlle Fleury|Eastern France]], defeating a [[Brice Petit|male]] from [[Maël Lozach|Western France]] with 7 votes from the jury.
**The name of the [[Vuro|yellow]] [[Virak|tribe]] began with the letter “V”
